en: Sepia-toned studio photograph showing a young woman and a man in a military uniform posed romantically. The woman wears a striped blouse with puffed sleeves, a long white skirt, and a small white headpiece. She is kneeling beside a wicker basket on the floor. The man, also kneeling, wears a double-breasted tunic with stand-up collar, shoulder boards, and a peaked cap, with a sword or sabre at his side. They lean toward each other as if in intimate conversation, against a painted backdrop resembling a soft, leafy garden scene.
